contract.activation: Bind the actual wearer/body plan and precise material component locations before using head as a coverage description.
contract.limits_and_failure: Nominal regional coverage is not complete protection and cannot imply thickness, fit, armor value, orientation or adjacent regions.
contract.acceptance: A head coverage tag without a corresponding actual protective component grants no resistance or inventory. Any uncovered subregion remains uncovered.
contract.maintenance: No independent maintenance; physical attached protection is maintained by the item/component owner.
contract.instance_binding: Coverage is a geometry descriptor, never an asset or lot. Modifying coverage does not materialize armor.
contract.overrides: Anatomies lacking the named region must map explicitly or mark the tag not applicable; no forced humanoid hit table.
contract.runtime: Resolve region intersection against current position/anatomy and real component coverage before consulting genre protection mechanics.
contract.portability: Applicable to any genre with compatible anatomy, protective equipment and contact geometry.
